title: Two windows, one screen? Snap them in 1 second 🪟 #Shorts
description:
Tired of switching back and forth between windows? One shortcut snaps your window to half the screen so you can work side by side.

⌨️ Windows: Win + Left Arrow (Win + Right Arrow for the right side)
🍎 Mac: Fn + Ctrl + Left Arrow (macOS 15 Sequoia or newer)

On Windows 11 you can also hover over the maximize button to pick a layout.

A new life-saving tip every day, in 15 seconds. Save this for later and subscribe 🔔
